title: hibiscus panduriformis var. tubulosus
intro: Hibiscus panduriformis var. tubulosus, commonly known as a variant of the Hibiscus panduriformis plant, is a species of flowering plant within the mallow family, Malvaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, headaches, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hibiscus panduriformis var. tubulosus include acting as an antipyretic, analgesic, and antispasmodic, helping to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and ease muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
